Fishing Rod.note: Every 3 combats upgrade a random card — live-validated (both A/B #3 runs carried it to good effect).

Arcane Scroll.note: Owner Neow rank 2026-07-25: top of the six -- a random Rare can anchor an Ironclad deck on the spot (their Stoke run); high variance, real whiffs, still the pick.

Booming Conch.note: Elite-combat draw; bot declines most elites, low uptime.

Cursed Pearl.note: 333g minus a curse; gold engine needs shop skill we lack.

Large Capsule.note: Owner correction 2026-07-25 (bot took it every Neow at 5.5): surprisingly mid -- the two junk cards are surprisingly punishing; ranked ~ Golden Pearl.

Lead Paperweight.note: 1-of-2 colorless; owner rank: above Lost Coffer only.

Leafy Poultice.note: Transform 2 basics at -10 Max HP; the HP is real money.

Lost Coffer.note: Card reward + potion. Owner rank: bottom of the six.

Neow's Torment.note: Owner rank: 2nd of six -- docked from ~4.5 for the BOT specifically: full value requires understanding tutoring, which the planner lacks.

Precarious Shears.note: Remove 2 for 13 damage; thinning is premium, hp-gate in _event covers the cost side.

Scroll Boxes.note: Owner: 1-of-2 packs of 3 class cards (1 uncommon + 2 commons, non-repeating), unskippable; costs all gold (~99 at Neow).

Hefty Tablet.note: 1-of-3 Rares + an Injury curse; rare quality for a small tax.

Kaleidoscope.note: 2 off-class card rewards; drafts blind off-class.

Neow's Bones.note: 2 random Neow relics + 1 random curse; relic economy usually wins.

Neow's Talisman.note: Upgrade 1 Strike + 1 Defend; modest but never dead.

Phial Holster.note: +1 potion slot + 2 potions — the potion policy cashes these (win #3 picked it blind at the clamp cap and it played fine).

Winged Boots.note: Ignore paths 3x — routing freedom the DP can spend on off-lane shops/rests.

Silken Tress.note: Lose all gold; Glam-enchant the first card reward (you keep ONE of its cards — one twice-a-combat card for ~99g). New-epoch boon, harvested live 2026-07-16.

Silver Crucible.note: 3 upgraded rewards vs one empty chest; fine trade.

Stone Humidifier.note: +5 Max HP per rest, compounds; bot rests often.

Alchemical Coffer.note: 4 potion slots + potions; potion pass made these count.

Archaic Tooth.note: Owner: Break = 1 energy, 20 dmg, 5 Vulnerable — a massive strict Bash upgrade. Provides are a proxy (BREAK has no tags/KB entry yet, so §5-C deck pricing is blind to it — filed).

Driftwood.note: Reroll every card reward once — selection quality all run.

Electric Shrymp.note: Owner: Imbued = the Skill auto-plays (tutored free) at the start of every combat. Strong with any good Skill; the enchant screen should prefer the deck's best scaling Skill.

Glass Eye.note: 5 cards at once; free quality but real bloat risk.

Prismatic Gem.note: +1 energy/turn; reward-pool dilution is the only tax. Energy is king. NB drafting sees off-class/colorless offers without Spirebird priors or tags (text-parse + rarity only) → systematically undervalued vs in-class; conservative but safe (owner: 'probably for the best' — cross-class Spirebird samples are abysmal anyway). Deep-future: busted cross-class combos lurk (Shiv/Ethereal generators + Feel No Pain + Ashen Strike — owner).

Radiant Pearl.note: Luminesce (KB): Retain, +2 energy, Exhaust — in hand every combat = ~2 flexible energy per fight.

Sand Castle.note: Upgrade 6 random cards on pickup — near Yummy Cookie tier for our mostly-unupgraded decks. (Day-one catalog gap: in the log harvest, missed from the wiki's Orobas list; fixed 2026-07-20.)

Noble Glass.note: See 15 Regent cards, add any number — free optionality (take zero if bad), but off-class cards draft blind (no priors/tags).

Venom Glass.note: Silent version of Noble Glass; same off-class caveat.

Touch of Orobas.note: Owner-confirmed: Black Blood = heal 12 post-combat, a strict Burning Blood upgrade — +6/combat is major attrition relief for a bot that bleeds every fight.

Pael's Blood.note: Passive +1 draw/turn — costs no card slot, so the drafted-draw energy caveat only half-applies.

Pael's Claw.note: Owner: Goopy = the Defend gains +1 Block permanently per play, but Exhausts on play — one use per fight, grows forever. Slow compounding for a real tempo tax.

Pael's Eye.note: Skip-turn tech the single-turn planner will never trigger deliberately; dead weight for the bot today.

Pael's Flesh.note: +1 energy from turn 3 on — the strongest common Pael offer.

Pael's Growth.note: Owner: Clone unlocks a rest-site action duplicating ALL Clone cards (1→2→4→8 with dedication). REPRICED 2026-07-21: the rest handler now takes Clone when an enchanted card exists (the §8.4 non-standard-action fix); still needs a premium enchant target to sing.

Pael's Horn.note: Relax (KB): 3 energy, 16 Block, next turn +2 draw +2 energy, Exhaust — real but unexciting cards; owner rated average.

Pael's Legion.note: Doubles a card's block every 2 turns. A/B #3's decisive boon: the owner picked it sensing a block-light deck, then drafted Barricade to bank the doubled block (93 banked in the Insatiable win).

Pael's Tears.note: Energy banking; the greedy planner rarely ends turns with surplus, so uptime is low for the bot.

Pael's Tooth.note: Remove 5, return upgraded over combats — genuine thinning+upgrades. (The old event heuristic's '+5 for remove' bait overrated it vs Legion, but it isn't a bad boon.)

Pael's Wing.note: Card-reward sacrifices → relic per 2. Synergizes with our high skip rate: skips become income.

Biiig Hug.note: Remove 4 for Soot-on-shuffle (Soot = unplayable Status). Thinning with a tax that grows as the deck thins (more shuffles) — self-limiting but net fine.

Golden Compass.note: Owner: a single guaranteed GOOD Act-2 route, 2 rooms longer (extra chest + fight), no choices. Bot-aware BONUS: a curated path sidesteps our own routing weaknesses entirely and adds income.

Nutritious Soup.note: Owner: Ember = Strikes cost 0, +3 dmg, Eternal. 0-cost 9-dmg Strikes are real tempo; Eternal locks them in the deck forever (anti-thinning tax on late-game quality).

Pumpkin Candle.note: +1 energy/turn, temporary (5 combats, kindle at rests / to Act 3 per variant); even temporary energy wins fights now.

Seal of Gold.note: Energy for 5g/turn — cheap tax at bot gold curves. (Log-only boon; wikis miss it.)

Storybook.note: Brightest Flame (KB): gain 2 energy, draw 2, lose 1 Max HP — owner: 'by far one of the strongest picks from Tezcatara'.

Toasty Mittens.note: +1 Strength/turn for top-deck exhaust; steady ramp, mild mill tax.

Toy Box.note: Owner: melt = leftmost goes permanently inactive every 3 combats — but on-pickup-effect relics lose nothing to melting, so expected value is better than it reads.

Very Hot Cocoa.note: +4 energy on turn 1 every combat — huge tempo; slightly below Flesh in long fights, above it in short ones.

Beautiful Bracelet.note: Owner: Swift 3 = first play each combat draws 3. Three enchanted cards = solid recurring velocity.

Brilliant Scarf.note: 5th card free; needs velocity the bot only sometimes has.

Delicate Frond.note: Full potion refill every combat — enormous with the potion policy actually drinking them.

Diamond Diadem.note: ≤2 plays → half damage; fights the planner's nature.

Fur Coat.note: 7 marked combats at 1 HP — free Act-3 normals.

Glitter.note: Owner: Glam = first play each combat plays twice. Every future draft arrives pre-improved; compounds with pick quality.

Looming Fruit.note: +31 Max HP in Act 3 is a real buffer.

Signet Ring.note: 999g — the A/B winner converted banked gold into 8 relics in Act 3. Requires shop competence; ours is adequate.

Claws.note: Owner: Maul = 1 energy, 5x2 dmg, ALL Mauls +1 dmg this combat — up to 6 self-ramping multi-hits from junk basics; multiplies with Strength. (MAUL still a KB gap for deck pricing.)

Crossbow.note: Free random attack in hand each turn.

Meat Cleaver.note: Owner: Cook = rest action, remove 2 cards + 9 Max HP — strong. REPRICED 2026-07-21: the rest handler now Cooks when thinnable cards exist (the §8.4 non-standard-action fix).

Sai.note: Passive 7 block/turn — pure survival, no play needed.

Spiked Gauntlets.note: +1 energy, Powers cost 1 more — mild tax. Owner picked it in the A/B #3 win.

Tanx's Whistle.note: Owner: Whistle = 3 energy, 33(44) dmg, Stun (delays the intent one turn; not a status — ignores Artifact; doesn't stack), Exhaust. One big tempo nuke per fight; best vs elites/bosses.

Throwing Axe.note: First card each combat played twice; scales with a big opener.

Tri-Boomerang.note: Owner: Instinct = doubles the card's attack damage — on your 3 best attacks. Scales with the deck's top-end.

War Hammer.note: Elite kill → 4 upgrades; the honest elite gate caps uptime until deck power rises.

Blood-Soaked Rose.note: Owner: Enthralled = 2-cost must-play-first Exhaust curse — a once-per-combat 2-energy tax when drawn, cheap rent on +1 energy/turn.

Choices Paradox.note: 1-of-5 retained card each combat; flexible value.

Distinguished Cape.note: Owner: Apparition = StS1's (1 energy, Ethereal, gain 1 Intangible; upgrade drops Ethereal). Premium for a human — but the combat sim doesn't model Intangible, so the planner scores it ~0 and lets it rot; bot-aware LOW until the sim learns Intangible, then reprice toward 6+.

Fiddle.note: +2 draw/turn but no in-turn draw — anti-synergy with drafted draw.

Jeweled Mask.note: Free random Power at combat start; scales with Power count.

Lord's Parasol.note: Entire merchant inventory free at next shop.

Music Box.note: Ethereal copy of first attack each turn.

Preserved Fog.note: Remove 3 for Folly (KB: unplayable Innate Ethereal Eternal curse) — permanently eats one turn-1 hand slot; the thinning usually still wins. (Log-only boon.)

Sere Talon.note: Owner: Wish = 0-cost chosen tutor from draw pile, Exhaust (upgrade: Retain). 3 tutors vs 2 random curses — better the spikier the deck's best card.

Whispering Earring.note: Owner: Vakuu spams your cards left-to-right until energy runs out (capped vs infinites). A dumb-but-energy-spending turn 1 as rent on +1 energy/turn — mild quality tax, worth it.

Black Star.note: Elites drop 2 relics; pairs with routing income work — value rises when the elite gate opens up.

Calling Bell.note: 3 relics for one unique curse; usually worth it.

Dusty Tome.note: Ironclad: Corruption+ — archetype-defining with exhaust payoffs (Feel No Pain), risky without.

Ectoplasm.note: Energy for a gold lock; hurts Act-3 shop conversion but energy wins the fights that get you there. (Log-only boon.)

Pandora's Box.note: Transform ALL basics — high variance mid-run when basics still carry the defense.

Runic Pyramid.note: Hand retention; even the single-turn planner benefits from bigger effective hands.

Snecko Eye.note: Draw 2 + Confused: randomized costs BREAK the planner's cost model — mispriced until the sim learns Confused. Deliberately low for the bot, not a statement about the relic.

Velvet Choker.note: Energy at ≤6 plays/turn; combat.py already models the card cap. (Log-only for DARV pool.)
